description.zh: 用水平滑动的轨道展示一组内容，同一时刻只突出一项，其余滑出视野或露出边缘作暗示。通过分页点、 箭头或自动播放切换，常用于首屏 Banner、图片画廊与推荐位。适合「一组同类内容、逐个浏览」的场景， 不适合需要并排对照的信息。
description.en: A horizontally scrolling track of items where one slide takes focus at a time and the rest slide out or peek at the edge as a hint. Switching uses dots, arrows or autoplay — common in hero banners, image galleries and recommendation rails. Fits "browse one item after another" content, not information that must be compared side by side.

use_when.zh: 一组同类内容需要逐个浏览（Banner、图集、推荐位）
use_when.en: A set of similar items browsed one at a time (banner, gallery, rails)

use_when.zh: 横向空间有限，又想保留「还有更多」的暗示
use_when.en: Horizontal space is tight but you still want a "more exists" cue

use_when.zh: 图片或卡片为主、文字说明简短
use_when.en: Image- or card-led slides with brief captions

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要并排对照多个项目（用卡片网格或表格）
avoid_when.en: Users must compare items side by side — use a card grid or table

avoid_when.zh: 内容只有三五条且全部重要（直接平铺，别藏起来）
avoid_when.en: Only three to five equally important items — lay them out flat

avoid_when.zh: 关键操作或表单藏在某一页里（切换会打断任务）
avoid_when.en: Critical actions or forms hidden on one slide — switching breaks the task

note.zh: 底部小圆点指示位置，点按直达，最省空间
note.en: Small dots mark position and jump directly — the most compact

note.zh: 左右箭头逐步切换，桌面端最常见
note.en: Prev/next arrows step through slides — the desktop default

note.zh: 定时前进，悬停或聚焦暂停；必须提供暂停入口
note.en: Timed advance with pause on hover or focus — a pause control is required

task.zh: 用键盘或箭头浏览完所有项目，观察焦点是否被正确管理。
task.en: Browse every item with arrows or keyboard; check focus is managed.

checks.zh: 切换后当前项有可见指示
checks.en: Current item is visibly indicated after switching

notes.zh: 轨道用 overflow-x: auto + scroll-snap-type: x mandatory，项目 scroll-snap-align: center， 纯 CSS 即可滑动；控件切换则用 transform: translateX(-index * 100%)。当前项用 aria-hidden 或 inert 降低朗读噪音，容器标 aria-roledescription="carousel"，切换时 aria-live="polite" 播报「第 n / N 项」。自动播放必须提供暂停按钮，并在 prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭。
notes.en: The track uses overflow-x: auto with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and items set scroll-snap-align: center so pure CSS scrolling works; control-driven switching animates transform: translateX(-index * 100%). Mark off-screen items aria-hidden or inert to cut screen-reader noise, label the region aria-roledescription="carousel", and announce "n of N" via aria-live="polite" on change. Autoplay needs a pause control and must shut off under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个轮播组件：水平滑动的轨道展示多个项目，用分页点和左右箭头切换。
basic.en: Create a carousel: a horizontally scrolling track of items switched by dots and left/right arrows.

design.zh: 创建轮播：轨道露出下一张边缘作暗示，当前项完整可见；底部分页点（当前项用主色加宽）， 左右箭头半透明悬浮在两侧，悬停显形；切换有 300ms 滑动过渡；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a carousel: the track peeks the next slide as a hint while the current slide sits fully in view; dot pagination below (active dot stretches in the accent color); translucent arrows float at the sides and sharpen on hover; 300ms slide transition; consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Carousel：activeIndex 受控；轨道 flex + overflow-hidden， 内层 translateX 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）；分页点与箭头同步 activeIndex； 键盘左右键切换，容器 role="group" + aria-roledescription="carousel"；自动播放用 setInterval，悬停/聚焦/暂停按钮停止；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind carousel: controlled activeIndex; a flex track with overflow-hidden and an inner translateX transition (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)); dots and arrows stay in sync with activeIndex; Left/Right keys switch, the container uses role="group" plus aria-roledescription="carousel"; autoplay via setInterval, stopped on hover, focus or the pause button; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 Carousel 轮播组件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Carousel component in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.
